$Comment: The Beasts foe family: the predators a foe-family bonus counts on. A creature that also rides with a faction (the Trork and Outlander wolves) belongs to that faction's family alone, so Beast leaves those roles out by name and no foe takes two families' bonus. Bosses and elites never count: every family excludes Zig_Boss_Or_Elite, the game's bosses and elites by exact role id. Add a role to ExcludeRoles to take it out too.
